dedupe_keys.name: transport scotland road network and traffic statistics

description: Transport Scotland publishes this small statistical dataset on Scotland's road network and traffic, drawn from the Scottish Household Survey and Scottish Transport Statistics. It holds the percentage of journeys perceived to have been delayed by congestion, road condition results from the Scottish Road Maintenance Condition Survey, and total vehicle kilometres on motorways, urban and rural roads. Coverage is council areas and the country, with annual values for 2003 to 2024. It is a single CSV file of 235 KB on data.gov.scot, free to download under the UK Open Government Licence v3.0, updated annually with the last update on 13 August 2026 and the next planned for 1 March 2027. Caveats: congestion figures are survey perceptions, not measured delays, there are no road-link counts, and the resolution is too coarse for network models. It suits capacity planning and resilience studies that need regional demand and maintenance context for the Scottish road system, and as calibration targets for national transport models. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
